question: What names and qualities define the seed called Kampinī in this teaching?
premises: The seed is identified as Kampinī.
It is also called by the name Caṇḍikā.
inference: The Kampinī seed is thus spoken of as the charming mantra named Caṇḍikā.
plain_english: The Kampinī seed is thus said to be the charming mantra named Caṇḍikā.
